text: I can define RPO and RTO, convert them into lost orders or revenue for a given system, and explain why each system gets its own targets.
I can estimate a restore's real RTO from data size, restore throughput and log replay time, and spot when a documented RTO is fiction.
I can design a backup scheme with point-in-time recovery, 3-2-1 placement, immutability and retention long enough to catch slow corruption.
I can explain, threat by threat, what replication protects against and what only a backup or delayed replica can recover.
I can choose between backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby and active-active for a system and state what each tier does not cover.
I can plan a failover drill that exercises fencing, DNS, hidden dependencies, capacity and failback, and records the measured RTO.
